title: Ferrari LaFerrari 混合動力工程
summary: 以「Ferrari LaFerrari 混合動力工程」為案例，逐步分析混合動力跑車的兩條能源路徑與峰值需求。十個單元各有機制、定量、驗證與診斷；所有數字是教學假設，共用物理模型依案例介面選用。
summaryEn: Use Ferrari LaFerrari hybrid engineering to analyze Two energy paths and peak demand in a hybrid sports car. Ten units connect mechanisms, calculations, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are teaching assumptions; shared physical models are selected for the case interfaces.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

steps.titleEn: Use requirements and test boundary | Ferrari LaFerrari hybrid engineering: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 使用需求與試驗邊界｜Ferrari LaFerrari 混合動力工程 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Use requirements and test boundary | Ferrari LaFerrari hybrid engineering and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 案例任務：混合動力跑車的兩條能源路徑與峰值需求。本單元觀察 熱機、電機、儲能、回生與冷卻邊界 中與「使用需求與試驗邊界」相關的介面。車型名稱不是試驗條件；先把乘員、貨物、續航與地形需求轉成載荷表。整車的輸入質量必須包含結構、能源系統及使用載荷。
steps.instructionEn: Case task: Two energy paths and peak demand in a hybrid sports car. In engine, motor, storage, regeneration and cooling boundaries, inspect the interface related to “Use requirements and test boundary”. A vehicle name is not a test condition. Convert occupants, cargo, range and terrain needs into a load table; input mass must include structure, energy storage and operating payload.
steps.observation: 明示教學假設，不是 Ferrari LaFerrari 混合動力工程 的原廠或實測規格。m_total=m_empty+m_payload；假設空車 1360 kg、載荷 240 kg。 計算結果 = 1600 kg。此為獨立教學工況；跨單元整合前先統一輸入、邊界及能量分配，再依模型限制解讀。
steps.observationEn: Explicit teaching assumptions, not manufacturer or measured specifications for Ferrari LaFerrari hybrid engineering. m_total=m_empty+m_payload; assume empty mass 1360 kg and payload 240 kg. Result = 1600 kg. This is an independent teaching operating point; reconcile inputs, boundaries and energy allocation before integrating units, then interpret within the model limits.
steps.failure: 若能耗或軸重突然改變，先核對是否把總重又加了一次電池或貨物；再比較量測日期與配置版本。
steps.failureEn: If energy use or axle load suddenly changes, first check whether the total already included the battery or cargo, then compare measurement dates and configuration versions.
steps.check: 核對每一項載荷只計入一次；用同一資料版本計算空載與滿載，保留被排除的拖車、乘員或附件。 將證據連回本案例的 熱機、電機、儲能、回生與冷卻邊界，註明照片只能證明可見配置，不能代替本步量測。
steps.checkEn: Check that every load is counted once; calculate empty and laden conditions from the same data version and list excluded trailers, people or accessories. 算出不合理高功率時，先查 rpm/rad·s⁻¹、kW/W 與不同採樣時間的錯配，再查感測器零點。
optionsEn: An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
The maximum-torque point must be the maximum-power point.
For implausible power, check rpm/rad·s⁻¹, kW/W and timestamp mismatch before sensor zero.
quiz.explanation: 算出不合理高功率時，先查 rpm/rad·s⁻¹、kW/W 與不同採樣時間的錯配，再查感測器零點。 在同一時間樣本配對扭矩與轉速，不相乘兩個不同時間的峰值；繪圖標示持續與短時能力。 將證據連回本案例的 熱機、電機、儲能、回生與冷卻邊界，註明照片只能證明可見配置，不能代替本步量測。
quiz.explanationEn: For implausible power, check rpm/rad·s⁻¹, kW/W and timestamp mismatch before sensor zero. Pair torque and speed at the same timestamp rather than multiplying unrelated peaks; distinguish continuous and short-duration capability on the plot. Link evidence to this case’s engine, motor, storage, regeneration and cooling boundaries; a photograph establishes visible arrangement, not the measurement required here.

automotiveExample.description: Mechanical power and operating point; synthetic inputs; not named-vehicle data
